reasoning: One trapezoidal step gives Y=1+(1/2)[−1+(1−Y³)], so Y+Y³/2−1=0. Newton's iteration Y←Y−(Y³/2+Y−1)/(3Y²/2+1), starting at 1, converges to approximately 0.770917. Rounded to two decimal places, this is 0.77, agreeing with Math Academy's worked solution.
